title: F35 F2.8 / electric single-element internal focus

parts.name: 01_FixedGuideBarrel
parts.role: One-piece fixed guide and rear stack barrel. G3 front flat bears on Z42.128372 shoulder; uniform OD34 rear body. No foil support or bonded cells.

parts.name: 02_L1Retainer
parts.role: Nominal M50.8 front cap; L1 -> fixed rear shoulder at Z10.9436.

parts.name: 03_L2MovingCell
parts.role: Moving L2 cell, OD45; mechanical rear shoulder plus one front retainer; 10.4 mm guide length. +/-2 mm axial only.

parts.name: 04_L2Retainer
parts.role: Nominal M40 removable L2 cap; 2.5 mm axial, 1.4 mm radial thickness.

parts.name: 09_L7Retainer
parts.role: Accessible nominal M28.8 rear retainer: L7 -> rectangular spacer -> G4 -> direct glass-rim contact -> G3 -> fixed front shoulder. No separate rear tube.

parts.name: 10_GearedCamRing
parts.role: Axially captured rotating cam ring. Three closed curved through-slots, external 80-tooth module0.8 involute gear, 20deg pressure angle; rotates +/-40deg without translation.

parts.name: 11_CamKeeper
parts.role: Nominal M53.6 threaded cam keeper; installs from rear before rear optical tube. Cam thrust clearance remains a demo assumption.

parts.name: 12_FrontThrustWasher
parts.role: 0.30 mm thrust shim; not a structural retainer.

parts.name: 13_RearThrustWasher
parts.role: 0.30 mm thrust shim; keeper sets cam axial capture.

parts.name: 14_InputPinion
parts.role: 16-tooth module0.8 input pinion, center distance38.4mm, rotation=-5*cam angle. Shaft/motor/support not modeled.

parts.name: 05_RearRectangularSpacer
parts.role: Simple thick rectangular spacer, 2.30714mm axial and2.6mm radial; G4 rear peripheral flat to L7 front peripheral flat. One rear retainer preloads entire rear stack.

stop.representation: No separate diaphragm; lens-bound opaque annulus defines candidate effective aperture near L4 rear surface. Coating is an annotation, not an extra solid.
stop.optical_validation: Pending ray tracing at all focus positions; no F-number equivalence claimed.

assembly_order: Preassemble L2 in moving cell with its front retainer
Install rear G3 cemented pair from rear onto fixed barrel front shoulder
Install rear G4 cemented pair from rear until revised peripheral annuli meet G3 at original STOP Z
Insert thick rectangular spacer, then L7, then close the entire rear stack with one accessible rear retainer
Fit cam ring, thrust washers, keeper and radial axles/rollers in the accepted order
Install input pinion and L1 with its front retainer
Check stroke, peripheral seating and preload; calibrate effective aperture and optical focus separately
warnings: Mechanical demonstration stroke only: the source contains no focus-position table. No near/infinity distance or optical performance is claimed.
Threaded retainers/cells are nominal interfaces; tooth forms of those screw threads are not modeled. Gear teeth and cam slots are explicitly modeled.
No motor, gearbox, bearings, encoder, switches, electronic control or camera bayonet is included.
Original Zemax/STEP remain unchanged. Four new rimmed reference blanks are explicit new-manufacture concepts; original optical sag and axial positions are preserved within original clear apertures.
Lens4 rear andLens5 front now meet only at r10.7..11.2; central optical air gap remains original. No thin foil, glued fixed cells or micro spacer at the old stop.

A physically opaque peripheral mask on a nearby lens surface is required for lens-integrated limiting aperture; merely assigning clear semi-diameter does not blacken the glass. Mask/coating shown only by annotation; ray tracing pending.
Rear preload now passes through glass peripheral annuli; force, bearing tolerances, coating exclusion/contact compatibility and centering fit need engineering verification.
